findings.current: “The privy’s in the imperial palace, so they’d even oiled the ceiling beams. I was holding on to one, but my strength gave out.”
findings.defect: The draft puts oil on the ceiling beams, changing Namho’s sarcastic explanation into a physical cause of his fall.
findings.rationale: Namho jokes that even the privy was well oiled, then says his strength failed while he held on to a ceiling support. He does not say the support was oiled.
findings.replacement: “Palace privy or not, the place might as well have been greased. I was hanging on to a ceiling beam when my strength gave out.”
findings.source: 황궁이라 그런지 측간에까지 기름칠을 잘 해 놨더군. 천장 기둥을 붙잡고 있는데 힘이 빠지지 뭐냐.

findings.defect: Namho is speaking and refers to Jeok Cheongang, not himself.
findings.rationale: The preceding assessment is Jeok Cheongang’s; Namho follows it by agreeing with the elder senior.
findings.source: 저 역시 노 선배의 말에 동감합니다.

findings.current: Why had she let me go when she’d had me completely under control?
findings.defect: The draft says So Gyo already had Taekyung under control; the source says she was in a position to subdue him.
findings.rationale: 제압 가능한 describes her capacity to overpower him, not a completed capture.
findings.replacement: Why had she let me go when she could have subdued me?
findings.source: 충분히 제압 가능한 상황에서도 나를 풀어준 이유.

findings.current: she must belong to the demonic, heterodox arts.
findings.defect: A person cannot belong to martial arts; the source places her among heterodox people or factions.
findings.rationale: 속한 인물 identifies the kind of person she is inferred to be, rather than naming an art she belongs to.
findings.replacement: she must be one of the demonic or heterodox martial artists.
findings.source: 암천의 주구 노릇을 하는 것을 보면 필시 사마외도(邪魔外道)에 속한 인물일 터인데

findings.current: But the army prepared over more than ten years under Ma Sanbao’s leadership was no joke either.
findings.defect: Calling it merely an army loses its purpose as a force seeking to restore legitimate rule.
findings.rationale: 반정군 specifies a restoration force, a distinction relevant to the planned struggle against the current Emperor.
findings.replacement: But the restoration army that had spent more than a decade preparing under Ma Sanbao’s leadership was no joke either.
findings.source: 마삼보를 중심으로 십 년이 넘는 세월 동안 준비해 온 반정군(反正軍)의 전력 역시 만만치 않을 것이다.

summary: The draft has three scene-fact errors and two meaningful terminology or context losses.
